info.name: MODERN Partner API - Documentation
info.description:
Authentication

All requests require bearer token authentication. Authorization: Bearer token

To get an access token, exchange the provided username and password via basic authentication to the /token endpoint. Authorization: Basic credentials

  • Access tokens are valid for 24 hours
  • Access tokens will give you access to a single franchise's data.
  • You will receive a username and password for each franchise that authorizes you to perform actions on their behalf.

Base URL

  • Production: https://connect.modernis.com

Support

Modern-Request-Log-ID Is a header that's returned on every request. You will need to store this value in order to receive support on specific requests.

Parameters

All parameters available are used in the request examples below. This does not necessarily mean they're all required.

request.description:
Retrieve a 24 hour access token. (If you need a longer token life, please contact devs@modernis.com)

  • Returns an object.

request.description:
Retreive a list of active MODERN dashboards.

  • Returns an array of objects.
  • The same work order number can live on multiple MODERN dashboards, though it is rare.

If you're unsure about what dashboard type you're looking for, you can request a list of active dashboard types for your franchise with the List Dashboard Types endpoint.

Examples of possible dashboard types:

  • field_service
  • shop_service
  • component_rebuilt
  • fabrication

query.description: String (optional) - Rather than a list of ALL dashboards, only the dashboard(s) where work orders containing the provided work order number were opened, will be returned.

request.description:
Change a work orders active event type and send notifications.

  • Returns an object.
  • If send_notification is true and notification is left empty, the default message will be sent for the event.
  • You can pass a notification_tags object with replacement values for any tags contained in the message string.
  • You can pass a technician object to assign a technician to the job. If the technician doesn't exist, it will be created.
  • If the event type you send is the same as what the work order is already set to, an event wont be created. You'll receive status: not_changed in the response object.
  • Only one of event_type_id or event_type_code is required. If both are sent, event_type_id will receive priority.
  • Only one of work_order_id or work_order_number is required. If both are sent, work_order_id will receive priority.
  • Make sure you have the Content-Type: application/json header.
  • The business name will be prepended to all messages.

request.description:
Create new work order(s)

  • Accepts a single work order object or an array of work order objects (up to 50 at a time)
  • Returns an object.

Parameters

root level

  • dashboard_id ::String - (required) Determines which dashboard a work order will open up on.
  • store_id ::String - The store or warehouse number/id. Will be used to filter unwanted work orders.
  • order_date ::String - When the work order was created in the ERP. Will be used to filter unwanted older work orders. (any parsable format is OK)

advisor - Assigns an advisor to the work order. Though this is optional, it's highly recommended. If you don't pass advisor data, a random admin advisor will be selected.

  • id ::String - Unique identifier. This can be anything unique and is configurable by the account owner within Modern.
  • email_address ::String - Email address the advisor uses to log in. This can be used in lieu of the ID.

work_order (required) - Object containing all of the relevant work order information

  • number ::String (required) - The work order number. This is used as a unique identifier with dupe checking.
  • overview ::String - A place to put customer complaint or other repair related information that's visible to the asset owner.
  • internal_overview ::String - Same as the overview, only not visible to the asset owner.
  • dashboard_indicator ::String - Will select a dashboard indicator if one matches this value. Example of dashboard indicators are Cash, Credit and Warranty.
  • promise_time ::String or Object - Either a date time string or an object containing the below paramaters. Used to set an estimated time of completion value. The format of all date time strings must be yyyy/mm/dd hh:mm:ss. Example: 2018/12/09 12:33:24.
    • date_time ::String - A date time string. This will be the promise time.
    • visible_to_customer ::Boolean - This defaults to false. Pass true if you want the promise time to be visible to customers.
  • priority ::String - A value of either "0", "1" or "2" that indicates the priority of the work order. 0 being normal priority, 1 being medium priority and 2 being high priority.
  • dupe_check - Used to turn on or off work order number duplication checks and the statuses checked against.
    • enabled ::Bolean - This defaults to true. If you don't want to perform any duplication checking on work orders, set this to false.
    • statuses :Array of Strings - This defaults to open, closed, deleted. If you only want to perform duplication checking on open work orders, set this to ["open"].

customer_business - The asset owner company information

  • id ::String - (required) The unique identifier for the customer business. If an existing customer business for the current dashboard is found with the ID, it will be used. If one cannot be found, it will be created.
  • name ::String - (required) The name of the customer business.

customer_contact - (required) The asset owner contact information

  • id ::String - (required) The unique identifier for the customer contact. If an existing customer contact for the current dashboard is found with the ID, it will be used. If one cannot be found, it will be created.
  • first_name ::String - (required) The first name of the customer contact.
  • last_name ::String - (required) The last name of the customer contact.
  • mobile_phone ::String - The phone number that updates will will be texted to.
  • email_address ::String - The email address that updates will be sent to..

asset (required) - Object containing all of the relevant equipment information.

  • id ::String - (required if serial_number is blank) The unique identifier for the equipment. If an existing equipment record for the current dashboard is found with this ID, it will be used. If one cannot be found, it will be created.
  • serial_number ::String - (required if ID is blank) The equipment serial number and secondary unique identifier. If an ID is not provided, the serial number will be used as the unique ID.
  • stock_number ::String - Internal stock number.
  • description ::String - Equipment description.
  • year :String - Equipment year.
  • make ::String - Equipment make.
  • model ::String - Equipment model.
  • hours ::String - Equipment hours.

technician - Assigns a technician to a work order

  • id :String - (required) The unique identifier for the technician. If an existing technician record for the current dashboard is found with this ID, it will be used. If one cannot be found, it will be created.
  • first_name :String - First name of the technician
  • last_name :String - Last name of the technician

department - Assigns a department to a work order

  • name :String - (required) Will select a department if one matches this value. Example of departments are Field Service, Component Rebuild, etc.

  • customer_city ::String - Example: "Denver"
  • customer_state_province ::String - (required) Example: "CO"

  • customer_country ::String - Example: "US"
